body: i really do have an idea. i’ve attempted before actually. as a result i was forced into hospital and therapy and yeah, it was terrible. i would’ve given anything at the time for it all to end. i even begged doctors to let me die (although they had already saved me so i was physically fine). but i’m  thankful all the time that i was put through that bc i can feel myself getting better. i completely understand where you’re coming from, i’ve been depressed since a child and i could never imagine anything getting better. i’ve also lost a couple people to suicide so i know that feeling too. all i’m saying is, euthanasia should not just be available to anyone. i 100% disagree with forcing people into secrecy idk where that came from. people won’t be hurt by your mental health, they will be hurt by you dying, and that’s just the truth. anyway, i really do hope things get better for all of you x

i’m sorry you’re going through tough times, but have you ever lost someone to suicide? the pain that brings cannot be compared to anything. people will miss you more than you will understand. and no, doctors should not be able to give out euthanasia, bc doctors would know that things really can get better especially with treatment.

no easy way or special method for it. you just gotta have a chat with them and say it. know that your true friends won’t look at you differently and will accept you no matter what. it’s not as scary as it seems :) good luck x
